paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
suggested_experiment_name: Combined ALP constraints (Belle II review, photon coupling)
notes: Paper presents revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity projections for ALPs coupling to photons (g_agamma in GeV^-1) over the keV-GeV mass range. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However, the numerical exclusion/sensitivity data are presented only in figures (Figures 2, 4, 7) without tabulated values, so no reliable (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted from the text. Both observed/revised constraints and projected Belle II sensitivities (90% CL projections; collider/beam dump constraints at 95% CL except BaBar at 90% CL) are shown. | Vision: Left panel of Figure 2 (photon coupling, g_aγZ=0). Lower boundary traced is dominated at low masses by SN 1987A (a→γγ) constraint floor near g~5e-10, rising through electron/proton beam dump regions, with a peak around m_a~0.7 GeV from collider constraints, then flattening at high mass. The right panel (hypercharge coupling) is similar.
